To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the structural information of scientific literature can help to identify more representative sentences.
the semantic link network in scientific paper can help ranking sentences and that the structural information can improve the performance of ranking sentences.

(1) using structural information in graph-based sentence ranking can improve sentence ranking performance, (2) using both structural information and semantic information can improve sentence ranking, and (3) the semantic link network is the most effective method for sentence ranking in scientific paper.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed method can be a useful tool in sentence ranking.
the structural information can be used in sentence ranking and the is-part-of and similar link are more effective than the co-occurrence in the graph based ranking methods.
the proposed method can help to identify representative sentences in scientific paper and the proposed methods can be used to improve text summarization and text classification.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the semantic link network is a good model for sentence ranking and it can be used to improve the performance of text summarization.
the structural information can be used as a feature for sentence ranking.
we proposed several different methods that can be applied to sentence ranking and we showed how the structural information of a scientific paper helps sentence ranking.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we should not neglect the structural information in scientific literature when we build the graph for ranking sentences.
structural information of a single scientific paper can help to rank sentences more effectively.
the semantic link network is a good model for ranking sentences in a single paper and it is also a promising method for ranking sentences in general texts.
